items.evidence: tasks.md 2.1: `Todo` struct (`id: Uuid`, `title: String`, `completed: bool`, `created_at: DateTime<Utc>`, `updated_at: DateTime<Utc>`)
proposal.md: "GET /todos" (with optional completed filter); tasks.md 5.2 lists handler returning `200` JSON array
spec.md: "GET /todos with an optional `completed` query parameter (`true` or `false`)"; tasks.md 3.2 and 6.2 cover filter parsing and tests
proposal.md: "PATCH /todos/:id"; tasks.md 5.4: partial updates with `200`/updated Todo or `400`/`404`
tasks.md 5.5: "DELETE /todos/:id` handler returning `204` empty body or `404`/`not_found`"
tasks.md 3.1: "trim; reject empty/whitespace-only; reject length > 200"; unit tests for exactly-200-char (valid) and 201-char (invalid)
design.md: "migrations via `sqlx::migrate!` embedded at build time, run once at startup before the listener binds"
spec.md: "GET /health returning `200` with `{ "status": "ok" }`"; tasks.md 5.6 implements health handler
proposal.md: "integration tests covering create, list, list-with-filter, get, patch, delete, and all specified validation/404 error paths"; tasks.md section 6 details CRUD, validation, and 404 tests

depth_note: Seven numbered task groups with checkbox items, inputs/outputs, and validation gates (tasks.md sections 1–7).
guardrails_note: design.md/tasks.md: Task Handoff Gate (pause after each task, wait for `do next`); Remote Mutation Rule (no push/PR without explicit user approval).
summary_note: Comprehensive OpenSpec-style plan with proposal, spec, design, and granular tasks; all f1 checklist items explicitly covered.
